subject: E-Commerce
title: The Power of Star Ratings
description: Learn The Power of Star Ratings in one minute.

hook.text: A product with 4.2 stars sells 190% more than the same product with 4.0 stars. A 0.2 difference is massive.

buildup.text: Star ratings compress complex opinions into a single number. Our brains love shortcuts for quick decisions.

discovery.text: Products between 4.2 and 4.5 stars sell best. Perfect 5.0 ratings look fake and reduce trust.

twist.text: A single one-star review can drop sales 10-15%. Negative reviews have outsized psychological weight.

climax.text: Star ratings are the most powerful social proof on the internet. A tiny number controls billions in commerce.

punchline.text: 0.2 stars, 190% more sales. A tiny number moves billions in e-commerce.

quiz.question: What star rating range sells best online?
